decisions.reason: The specific Hong Kong adoption resolved the key uncertainty favourably and data centre connectivity remains strategically valuable, so the option is unlikely to be dropped.
Optical spectrum connectivity builds on the firm’s optical strengths and aligns with high-bandwidth cloud demand, so the valuable upside warrants keeping the option open.
The voice number ordering portal is a low-cost digital extension with market potential still unresolved, so the firm keeps the cheap option rather than abandoning it early.
Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony service whose value has become unlikely to be realised amid industry decline, so the option should be abandoned.
